in_sanskrit.name: वेदाङ्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वेद (veda) meaning knowledge + ाङ् (ang) meaning base or origin. Thus, Vedang can be interpreted as 'the origin or base of knowledge' or 'the foundation of scripture'.

in_hindi.name: वेदाङ्
in_hindi.meaning: ज्ञान (jñāna) meaning knowledge + ाङ् (ang) meaning base or origin. Thus, Vedang can be interpreted as 'the origin or base of knowledge' or 'the foundation of scripture' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: வெடங்
in_tamil.meaning: ஜ்ஞானம் (jñānam) meaning knowledge + ங் (ṅ) meaning base or origin. Thus, Vedang can be interpreted as 'the origin or base of knowledge' or 'the foundation of scripture' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: వెదంగ్
in_telugu.meaning: జ్ఞానము (jñānamu) meaning knowledge + ఙ్ (ṅ) meaning base or origin. Thus, Vedang can be interpreted as 'the origin or base of knowledge' or 'the foundation of scripture' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Vedang
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vedang हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vedang means 'knowledge' or 'wisdom' in Sanskrit and Hindi. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'veda' which means 'knowledge' or 'wisdom'. The name is used to convey the idea of a deep and profound understanding of the world around us.
